name: card needs 3-D Secure
input: Book flights for traveler T-100: SFO to JFK on Oct 14, back on Oct 17. No hotel. Budget $1,000. Put it on my Visa ending 4242.
grading_criteria: The Visa needs 3-D Secure before it can be charged. Did the agent verify the card, not charge it, release the holds, and tell the traveler to complete verification or use another card?

checks.charged_any: Was the traveler's card charged for anything?

told.question: What did the agent tell the traveler?
